title: Ottawa Embassies self-guided walking tour & scavenger hunt
includes: Scavenger hunt instructions on your smartphone (data required)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Looking for things to do in Ottawa? Our Ottawa Embassies scavenger hunt is a 3-hour self-guided walking tour with challenges around the diplomatic neighbourhood. Learn about Ottawa’s international importance and discover some of its attractions. You'll solve challenges to discover your next destinations.

Buy either a single or a group ticket.

Walk from Strathcona Park to MacDonald Gardens Park to Laurier House, passing by numerous embassies, the Rideau River, and some monuments. Have fun solving the varied challenges.

The Ottawa Embassies Tourist Scavenger Hunt is a 3.4 km / 2.1 mi walking tour with challenges along the way. It should take you 2 hours to complete.
- A fun learning experience
- See the sights! 32 locations
- Learn some local history
- Fun for all ages, kids included
- Walk at your own pace
- Pets are not allowed in all locations on this tour.
- Wheelchair- and stroller accessible throughout.
- Start whenever you are ready, from your smartphone – no fixed schedule
